caption: Clinics and Hospitals are subdomains; US South and Alaska are workspaces assigned directly. Domain settings is next.
A domain's identity: just a name and an optional description.
Domain admins can change domain settings and add or remove workspaces — the broadest control over one domain.
A narrower role: who can add or remove workspaces from the domain, scoped to the org, specific users/groups, or admins only.
By workspace name, by workspace admin, or by capacity — the capacity option assigns many workspaces at once.
